liquid.survey: Statistics Canada, Survey of Financial Security 2023 (table 11-10-0049-01)

note: The World Inequality Database (WID.world, bulk download of 15 October 2026), Canada, 2024: average net personal wealth (ahwealj992) and average post-tax disposable income (adiincj992) per adult over 20, resources split equally within couples, in CAD of that year, for the bottom 20, 40, 60, 90 and 99 percent and the top 1 percent; each family's band is read from them. Read 2026-10-30. Savings (the owner's ruling of 2026-10-30: only what a family holds as deposits and cash): Statistics Canada table 11-10-0049-01 (Survey of Financial Security, assets and debts by net worth quintile, file of 29 October 2024, the 2023 survey), Canada, estimates: "Deposits in financial institutions", net worth, total assets and total debt as totals in millions of 2023 constant dollars, the number of family units in thousands, and for deposits the percentage of total assets, the percentage holding and the average for holders. The per-family means are my division of the totals by the family count. The full CSV (101 MB) was cut to the 2023 Canada estimate rows for these four items, kept verbatim in the extract; said parts quote the cells of those rows. Deposits here exclude TFSA and registered plan balances held as deposits (they are separate items). No top 1 percent.
